verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's official CLI natively runs batch operations over many files at once: wildcard conversion (`--convert-to ... *.doc`), batch print-to-file, printing multiple files, and text dumps, all usable headless. A community user corroborates running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats. Bulk scope is limited to conversion and printing; other bulk edits depend on macros or the UNO API, which are developer building blocks rather than a bulk-operation feature. missing for 10: documented bulk editing or transformation of content across many files or items beyond conversion and printing, documented bulk operations within an app (e.g. many rows or objects), and independent hands-on corroboration of batch performance at scale

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
